==Usage==
Use the template to add an apostrophe when it is surrounded by the same apostrophe symbols, which create text in ''italics'' or in '''bold'''. For example:

<pre>The ''[[Colossus]]''{{'}} engines were damaged.</pre>
The ''[[Colossus]]''{{'}} engines were damaged.

==See also==
If adding an apostrophe with "s" to italicized or bolded text, use the {{Tlx|'s}} template ([[Template:'s]]) instead.
